messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. The final line of your response must be exactly: "She smiled at him.". Write 250 characters or more. End your response with this exact line: "She smiled at him.". Use at most 200 characters in total. (Characters include letters, punctuation, spaces, and newlines.) No title line—start directly with the content. Use every punctuation mark in this list at least once: [','].
